about.label: Who am I
about.title: About
paragraphs: Fullstack developer based in Rennes, I am pursuing a master's degree in web development while working as a fullstack developer apprentice. My training has given me a strong command of web and mobile development, from frontend to backend.
Alongside my studies, I founded DVS Web, my freelance activity where I help businesses create their digital projects: showcase websites, web applications, e-commerce and SEO optimization.
Wearing both the apprentice and entrepreneur hats allows me to combine technical rigour with hands-on experience, delivering concrete, high-performing solutions.

In the workplace as in freelancing, my developer background gives me a fine understanding of technical challenges, which I sharpen daily through project management, coordination and delivery follow-up.
